verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's own API lets businesses submit documents and manage signers within notarization workflows, and it auto-detects signature fields on submitted documents. That is a legally binding signing flow with signers, but it is framed as notarization rather than a general e-signature product, and nothing shows multi-recipient routing or signing order. missing for 10: explicit e-signature (non-notarized) flow, documented support for multiple recipients per document, routing/signing-order configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send a document for legally binding e-signature to multiple recipients with routing

citations.quote: businesses can submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows
This endpoint creates a notarization request for a document
Signature and location/date fields will be automatically identified across the entire document using AI-powered detection.
